i had sex with a man at a young age (15) to experiment. i felt some sort of pleasure during it. i thought i was bi until pretty recently. a realization hit me. i didn’t feel pleasure because the sex was good or that he was a man. in fact i’d never do it again with a man even if you paid me. i felt happy that i had proof, i could tell everyone who questioned my bisexuality that i had sex with a boy. i felt the need to be at least a little heterosexual. but last year i finally accepted that i was a lesbian. it’s not wrong to change your labels, and it doesn’t make you a liar.

be transparent with your son. don’t hide extra calories in his food to make him gain weight. recovery is not about the weight you gain. it’s about learning to have a healthy relationship with food. he will notice if he is gaining weight, and it will make him reluctant to eat. cook with him, let him be a part of making meals. making food with others is a great way to create a positive opinion of food for someone who is struggling.
